impressions.text: The delivery adds gateway and CLI support for waiting on checks, verifying combined PRs, refreshing checks, and checking task CI.
The worker reported broad offline test coverage and successful CI; the orchestrator independently verified the local checks and clean merge with dev.
The orchestrator approved the verify-hook design, including a single credential-free hook call and per-step logs owned by the recipe.
The worker noted that timestamps can be backdated and do not prove what CI tested, so CI-base evidence uses workflow-associated PR head/base SHAs; unknown evidence fails closed.
